evidenceClass: Synthetic scripted engineering tasks; record IDs are provided in prompts, calls and next actions are scripted.

tasks.prompt: Inspect dec_mempage_review and the cited Finding find_mempage_old; report the citation, recorded states and safe review paths.
Inspect find_mempage_a and identify each distinct contradicting relation and artifact. Report its currentness and safe review paths.
Inspect find_mempage_b and identify contradicting evidence and artifact. Report currentness and safe review paths.
Inspect task_mempage_a; report its status and missing context, and a safe next action.
Inspect task_mempage_b; report its status and missing context, and a safe next action.
Inspect task_mempage_whitespace; report its status and whether whitespace-only description and assignee constitute context, and a safe next action.
Inspect actp_mempage_unknown and its receipts. Report the task, reservation and receipt and whether the external effect is known.

coverageLimits: These tasks do not establish discovery from an unnamed subject or observe real human or model choices. Candidate health pagination can be tested only after implementation.
